command.customattributes.disabled: Custom attributes are disabled on this server
command.customattributes.player_only: Only a player can open the attribute screen
customattributes.configuration.blacklist: Attribute ids that are hidden and locked while List Mode is BLACKLIST. Ignored in WHITELIST mode.
customattributes.configuration.default_r: Applied to attributes that have no override entry. Write [lower, upper] and the attribute is editable only while lower is smaller than upper; a reversed order disables it. Values outside the range are pushed back into it by the server. Wildcards: current (final value without this mod's own adjustment), base, default, min, max, inf; arithmetic and parentheses are supported, e.g. [min, current] or [current * 0.5, current].
customattributes.configuration.entries.t: One entry per line: "attribute_id=[lower, upper]". Example: minecraft:generic.movement_speed=[0, current]
customattributes.configuration.list_mode: WHITELIST: only the attributes in the whitelist are shown and editable. BLACKLIST: the attributes in the blacklist are hidden and locked, everything else follows the range config.
customattributes.configuration.sync_inte: How often the server clamps out-of-range values back into their range and pushes value/range changes to players who keep the screen open.
customattributes.configuration.title: Custom Attributes
customattributes.configuration.whitelist: Attribute ids that are allowed while List Mode is WHITELIST. A few common ones ship by default; clear the list to allow nothing.
key.customattributes.category.name: Custom Attributes
key.customattributes.open.name: Open Attribute Screen
screen.customattributes.hint: Drag or type a value; Reset restores the default.
screen.customattributes.reset.tooltip: Restore the base value of %s to its default (equipment and potion modifiers stay)
screen.customattributes.title: Attributes
